PagerDuty Bot: PAGER: hosted-runtime-prod - kvcache memory pressure >= 92% on node gpu-14 (auto-escalate)
Alex (oncall): acked. i'm looking. any customer-facing 5xxs? :eyes:
Priya (CS): yes i just got a message from BrightCo — they saw generation failures ~5m ago, some 503s and timeouts. giving them a heads up.
Liz (runtime): seeing a big spike in long prompt sessions from tenant=brightco-prod starting ~1977769800. continuous-batching window is growing KV entries per request. looks like prefetch combined w/ long context is duplicating KV entries.
Kunal (sre): that sounds like the prefetch->kvcache feedback loop we talked about. if prefetch fetches prefix KV and batching groups long contexts repeatedly, memory can amplify. can you share top keys?
Liz (runtime): grabbing top keys now — output snippet:
```
# top kvcache usage by prefix (node gpu-14)
prefix:customer:brightco:session: 42% of cache
prefix:common:system: 8%
prefix:customer:trial-*: 3%
total_kv_entries: 1.2M
avg_kv_entry_bytes: 2.1KB
```
Liz (runtime): also seeing continuous-batching window size jump from 8 -> 128 for ~300s on that node. prefetch_count configured to 16 for hosted rollout.
Alex (oncall): impact summary? how many requests failed vs degraded latency?
Runtime CI: metric snapshot (1977770020):
- 5xx count (1m): 74 (baseline 2)
- p95 latency tokens: 3.2s -> 9.7s
- evicted_kv_entries/min: 0 (OOM, not eviction)
Kunal (sre): OOM risk confirmed. short term we should stop prefetch for that node pool and lower batch_window for hosted runtime. will that be doable without a code deploy?
Marta (eng): we can flip the prefetch flag per pool via config. hotpatch endpoint ready: /admin/feature-flags
Marta (eng): recommended immediate actions:
- disable prefetch on pool hosted-gpu-14
- set continuous_batch_window_max=16
- force kvcache.gc on the node
Alex (oncall): do the config flips. i'll open a mitigation runbook thread and start customer comms.
Marta (eng): commands to run (ops only):
```
# disable prefetch for pool
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/flags -d '{"pool":"hosted-gpu-14","flags":{"prefetch":false}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
# limit batch window
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/config -d '{"pool":"hosted-gpu-14","continuous_batch_window_max":16}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
# trigger kvcache GC
ssh ops@gpu-14 "sudo /opt/runtime/bin/kvcachectl --gc --force"
```
Kunal (sre): i'll throttle ingress for brightco-tenant at the edge to reduce ongoing amplification while we apply changes.
Alex (oncall): Priya please triage CS comms. state: mitigation in progress, potential partial degradation, working on hotfix.
Priya (CS): on it. telling BrightCo we're mitigating and will follow up in 30m. asking for any correlative logs from their side.
Runtime CI: patch job started: config patch queued id=cfg-19777701
Deploy Bot: config rollout started for pool hosted-gpu-14 -> disabling prefetch
Marta (eng): prefetch flag flipped on hosted-gpu-14 at 1977770123. now applying batch window limit.
Deploy Bot: config rollout succeeded for continuous_batch_window_max=16 at 1977770190
Runtime CI: ssh to gpu-14 returned kvcache size now 640MB (down from 2.5GB). GC completed. active KV entries down to 220k.
Liz (runtime): seeing immediate drop in memory on node set. continuous-batching windows are back to 8-12. p95 latency stabilizing.
Alex (oncall): any 5xxs still firing?
Runtime CI: 5xx count (5m): 3 — trending to baseline.
Priya (CS): BrightCo confirmed generation resumed, still validating outputs. they saw approx 20 failed calls earlier; CS will reconcile billing for impacted requests.
Kunal (sre): next step: gradual rollout of safer prefetch profile. we should not re-enable prefetch globally until we have a throttled prefetch size + per-tenant limits and a guard that prevents duplication when batch_window>prefetch_count.
Marta (eng): agreed. action items:
- create a prefetch safety gate (engine) to limit prefetch tokens per request and per-tenant (owner: Marta)
- add telemetry alert for prefetch+kvcache growth pattern (owner: Liz)
- run a canary with brightco traffic sim (owner: Kunal)
Alex (oncall): i'm handing off to Liz for next shift monitoring. if anything regresses, page me immediately.
Liz (runtime): taking handoff. will monitor memory and p95 for the next 4 hours. scheduling post-incident sync at 1977773600.
PagerDuty Bot: RESOLVE: incident resolved for hosted-runtime-prod (auto-clear) - 1977770500
Alex (oncall): thanks everyone — great quick work. postmortem owner: Alex. i'll draft and assign follow-ups in the incident board.
Priya (CS): closing loop with BrightCo, will escalate if they need credits. noted 20 failed calls, customer impact limited to that window.
Marta (eng): quick note: we should also audit the prefetch rollout canary flags. looks like hosted rollout pushed prefetch to 80% of pools; need safer ramp.
Kunal (sre): saved the temporary mitigation commands and will prepare a hotfix PR to make the prefetch toggle less risky.
Alex (oncall): handoff complete. Liz, Kunal, Marta, Priya on watch. tag me if anything pops.
Liz (runtime): ack. adding telemetry dashboard panels and a playbook section for this exact feedback loop.
Marta (eng): also creating a unit test in runtime that simulates prefetch + large batch windows to catch regressions.
Alex (oncall): good. closing thread, will post the postmortem link here once written.
